text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp had finally come to 
an end...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Aside from training, there's something I'd 
like to take care of.
choice_data_list: Something you want to get done?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...Anyway, I'll call on you one day. 
When that time comes, I'm counting on you.

Once summer is over, the decisive battle 
will be right upon us...!
